semantics.exact_statement: On a finite-dimensional real typed channel, the registered product-ball, positive-definite ellipsoid, and certified centrally symmetric spanning H-polytope gauges have the declared unit sublevels. If H is contained in the registered anchor body A, u in H implies rho_A(u) <= 1, with no converse. For an invertible anchor scaling D, rank(RD)=rank(R) and R u=(R D)(D^-1 u). The exact J1 outer-envelope and J2 dependence constructions restrict the corresponding unqualified strong conjectures.

symbol_type_domain_map.R: real m by n response matrix
symbol_type_domain_map.D: invertible real n by n anchor scaling
symbol_type_domain_map.N: strictly positive random numerator in J2 fixture
symbol_type_domain_map.B: strictly positive random anchor in J2 fixture

assumptions: All coordinates compared in one gauge have identical coordinate labels, frame, normalization, perturbative order, and branch.
Product-ball radii are strictly positive and blocks cover each coordinate exactly once.
Ellipsoid Q is real symmetric positive definite.
Runtime H-polytopes have positive bounds, spanning normals, and an antipodal halfspace for every halfspace.
Rank invariance is asserted only for invertible D on the declared anchored supported subspace.
The J2 counterexample targets joint-law-free or marginal-only calibration, not every test under a fully registered joint law.
branches: finite conditional family reported as an interval
nonconvex union reported only by conditional component gauges
exclusions: No MES converse or physical-set equality is assumed.
No random-anchor raw excess is assumed to be an e-value.
No missing or withheld channel is replaced by zero.
No nonconvex union is assigned one sublinear gauge.
boundary_or_initial_conditions: the anchor body contains the origin
the gauge unit boundary is rho=1
the exact J1 probe is u=1/2
the J2 atoms have probability 1/2 each

target.canonical_form: Exact rational values and Boolean theorem checks in the registered runtime scope; no converse, uniqueness, evidence, or physical proximity conclusion.
target.equivalence_relation: exact equality over rationals for fixtures and theorem equality or iff under the declared real-domain assumptions
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not assume the target identity in an intermediate rewrite.
Do not import sibling solver scripts or results before adjudication.
Do not substitute a finite nuisance grid for a continuous family.
Do not infer physical equality or uniqueness from outer containment.
Do not calibrate J2 from marginals while ignoring the joint law.
Do not report invertible scaling as information or rank gain.

wolfram_xact.obligation: Independent exact verification in Wolfram Language; load xAct and report its version even though the registered claims are scalar and matrix algebra.

sympy.obligation: Independent exact symbolic and rational verification in SymPy.

pinned_toolchain.python: venv/bin/python or system Python with SymPy 1.14.0

sage_singular.obligation: Independent exact verification in SageMath; load Singular and record its version.

lean.obligation: Faithful theorem formalization and compiled proof under formal/lean-toolchain, plus exact fixture values.

independence.script_result_ownership: per-axis; scripts and outputs are never shared before parent-owned run-adjudicate execution
independence.correlation_disclosure: record when one LLM family authored multiple axis scripts; engine agreement is not derivation independence

exceptions_adjudication.aggregate_status_rule: R3 requires CAS_4AXIS_PASS; failures are CAS_PASS_WITH_REGISTERED_EXCEPTION, CAS_CONFLICT, CAS_BLOCKED, or CAS_FAIL
